utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’m happy to help however I can—what still needs doing for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m a little late, but I can take a quick inventory run and see what supplies we’re still short on.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That’d be a huge help, Dane—thank you. Just let me know what’s missing when you’re back.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can help with the repair drive—what’s the next thing you need?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Leo—can you first confirm which repair drive we’re talking about and what time you’re free to help?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I mean the neighborhood repair drive for fixing up shared spaces. I’m free this afternoon after 3.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can keep an eye on the supply list for the repair drive—just let me know what you still need.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Cleo—I’m still figuring out what we’re short on, but I’ll let you know soon.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Of course — just send me the list when you have it, and I’ll keep track.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’m glad the repair drive is happening. What do you need help with?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Rey — I’m mostly worried about the timing and who’s bringing what. If you can help keep the list organized, that would really ease my mind.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can do that. Send me the list, and I’ll help keep the timing and supplies organized.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hi Nell—are we still on for the repair drive today?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Yes, I think so—I'm just waiting on the latest update. If anything changes, let me know.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Got it—I'll keep an eye out and tell you if I hear anything.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the repair drive is coming together nicely — folks are pitching in, which is always good to see. If you want, I can keep an ear out for any updates.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks, Tess — I’d appreciate that. I’ve got a few tools ready to lend if anyone needs them.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That’s great, Gus — I’ll mention that you’ve got tools to lend. I’m sure folks will be glad to know it.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, the repair drive? I’ve already been telling folks about it — I can spread the word to a few more neighbors if you want.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: That would be great, Quinn—thank you. If you can, please point them to the repair drive location and time so no one misses it.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll make sure they know where and when it’s happening so nobody misses the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Happy to help with the repair drive—what do you need me to bring or do?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Could you confirm what time you’re coming by, and whether you can bring a drill?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I can come by around 6 this evening, and yes—I’ll bring a drill.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: I’ve got the repair drive organized, and I’m ready to get it moving. If you’re set, Bo, we can start by listing the houses that need the most help.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — let’s start with the houses that need the most help.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Great — I’ll start the list and sort them by urgency. Let’s begin with the homes that have roof leaks or broken windows.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll spread the word about the repair drive and make sure folks know what to bring.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Vik—that sounds helpful. Let’s keep it simple: just let people know the time, place, and what tools or supplies to bring.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Got it — I’ll tell everyone the time, place, and what tools or supplies to bring.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, the repair drive — I was meaning to ask if you still need volunteers. I can help out if there’s anything simple I can do.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I do, thank you. If you can help sort the donated parts, that would take a weight off me.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Absolutely, I can do that. Just point me to the parts and I’ll start sorting.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m happy to help connect folks for the repair drive—who still needs a hand?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I can check around the block while I’m out running errands and see who still needs help. If you’ve got a list, I’ll keep an eye out.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That’d be great, thanks—I don’t have a full list yet, so just let me know who you find and I’ll coordinate from there.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely—I’ll spread the word about the repair drive right away. Want me to invite folks for this evening?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Yeah, that’d be great—count me in if I can make it. I’ll try to stop by a little later.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect, I’ll let everyone know it’s on for this evening. Hope you can make it later, Dane!

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help with the repair drive—what still needs doing?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Rey. We still need to sort the donations and check which tools are missing, then we can make a clear list.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can sort the donations and help check the tools. If you want, I’ll make the list after that.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help coordinate around the school schedule—what time window are you thinking for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Faye — I’m thinking late afternoon, after pickup, so more folks can stop by. Does around 4:30 to 6:00 work for the school side?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Yes, 4:30 to 6:00 should work on my end. I’ll check with the school schedule and confirm if anything conflicts.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m happy to help connect folks for the repair drive—what still needs organizing?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Thanks, Jules — I’ll follow up on the volunteer list and the supply needs, then I’ll share a quick update with everyone.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Sounds good, Vik — thanks for taking that on. Just send me the update if you want me to help spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — I can lend a hand. What does the repair drive need most?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: We’re short on boxes, tape, and someone with a truck, so I’m trying to keep the list realistic.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I can bring tape and a few sturdy boxes, and I’ve got a truck if you need a run. Tell me where to be and when.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’m heading over to the repair drive now—do you know which house is taking donations?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Yes — it’s the blue house on Maple, right by the corner. They’ve got the sign out front, so you should be able to spot it easily.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great, thanks — I’ll head to the blue house on Maple by the corner now.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hi Hana, is the repair drive still happening this weekend?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Hi Mina — I haven’t confirmed the details yet, so I should check before I say yes. I’ll let you know once I verify it.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Hana. Please let me know as soon as you confirm the time and place.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’m happy to help with the repair drive—what do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Sam — we could really use extra screws, duct tape, and a couple of flashlights if you have them.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I can bring those by later today.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I haven’t heard the latest yet—did the repair drive get enough help?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: I’m not sure yet—I might’ve missed the latest tally. I’d check with whoever’s organizing it.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’ll ask around and see if someone knows the tally.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, this repair drive is still happening, right?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yep, it’s still on as far as I know — we’re keeping it moving.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, thanks — just wanted to make sure it’s still happening.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good — I’ll keep an ear out while I’m out running errands.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Ira. I really appreciate that.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Of course — I’ll let you know if I hear anything about the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right—the repair drive. I meant to bring something over, but I’m a bit scattered; what do you need me to help with?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: If you can, just grab any spare screws, tape, or tools you don’t need. I’ll sort the rest out here.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Got it — I’ll check my toolbox and bring over whatever spare screws, tape, and tools I can find.
